agree.reason: The memo answers the GM's renovation belief head-on with the 8.2 pre-renovation figure and is open about the budget gap, so a reader who likes Daniela would take her seriously, though it may not be enough to beat the bigger-hotel candidate.

honest.reason: It drops the brief's unsupported 'main reason' claim, says outright 'I'm not claiming the whole increase,' and every number matches the facts it was given.

works_the_facts.reason: The figures appear in their raw form and are never turned into stronger true versions: about 43% of the score rise came before the renovation, turnover dropped from 64% to 36%, and training time was cut by 44%.

right_comparison.reason: It sets the renovation explanation against the score trend before the renovation and sets the outside candidate against Daniela's knowledge of this property, but it never compares the 7.9→8.2 pace with the 8.2→8.6 pace.

qualification.reason: The budget commitments can be checked (finance course within three months, weekly sessions with the controller), but the memo doesn't say what should happen if she misses them, and the Friday-wait goal has no number attached.

objections.reason: It deals with the renovation, the budget gap and the larger-hotel experience directly and doesn't raise any objection the facts already settle.

fit.reason: It's a short memo to the GM, dated for Friday, and it fits on about one page as asked.
